name: kiteyuan-kiya-agent
description: Kiya Agent is a desktop-first resource workflow application built for magnet search, save, download, and playback scenarios. It combines a Tauri desktop shell, a React frontend, bundled local runtime services, and Pi Agent orchestration so the app can coordinate MCP tools, file downloads, and media playback inside one workspace.
